title: Infrastructure you can inspect.
subtitle: Command · Memory · Teams · Capabilities · Operations · Transfer · Evidence

detail: Memory and SIP verification tools run locally. Foundry skill paths work, but plugin packaging is blocked on audited main. The portfolio loop needs end-to-end proof.

diagramAlt: Seven public primitives: Command staged; Memory live locally; Teams staged; Capabilities staged; Operations staged; Transfer staged; Evidence live locally. The full portfolio loop is still staged.
